title: Standardising text: case, accents, whitespace and abbreviations

videos.script: Twenty-eight ways to write five cities. That is where lesson 1 left the customer file. {{start}} Most of the differences are mechanical. A space after the word. Capitals. A missing accent. An accent stored as a separate character, invisible on screen. {{mechanical}} And one is a small disaster. Text that was read with the wrong encoding, years ago, and saved that way. São Paulo with a capital A and a pound sign in the middle. {{mojibake}} Each of those has a general fix, cheap and safe, that you can apply to any text column. Step by step, the twenty-eight become eleven. {{steps}} The last step is different. BH is Belo Horizonte, and no rule knows that. Somebody has to write it down. {{abbrev}} This lesson does each step in pandas and in SQL, counts what it changed, and keeps one rule throughout. Clean a copy for matching. Never rewrite the name a person typed. {{end}}
